› short bullet points: what is a named pipe on Windows


• • A named pipe is a Windows communication channel that lets two processes exchange data, even if they’re running as different users or on different computers.
  • One process creates and listens on the pipe; another connects to it.
  • It has a name such as \\.\pipe\my-app.
  • Apps commonly use named pipes for local client–server communication. Windows can control who is allowed to connect.
